stream: q3h die-top broadcast, v5 stations variant on the FINAL grid (Q-DIEPLAN3-HT, 2026-10-16)
function: registers the 1,567-b head-row word {go, ib 379, desc 73, fill 1114} once; drives (1) its own xcol head (e_d / w_d) and (2) the next station outward.  One station per head, in the ~393-um gap on the head's centre side; the chain alternates lane L / lane U under / over the head between two stations (instances alternate MX), so each lane carries one 1,567-b trunk.  Down path only: the reduction (D3) runs on relay lanes in the band gaps / die-edge channels.

PAD.note: retired: equal-age pads moved to the head outputs

frame.note: as tall as the w130 head (920.16); 330 wide in the 393-um gap between heads (31.6 um each side)

ports.name: d_in
ports.note: from the inner station via lane U (MX / R180 instances: S face, lane L)

ports.name: d_out0
ports.note: to the outer station via lane L (MX / R180 instances: N face, lane U)

ports.name: d_out1
ports.note: this station's head e_d (W) / w_d (E), across ~32 um

pin_rule: <= 6 pins/um per face over all layers (pitch >= 0.167 um)

placement.orientation: W: alternating MX (even k) / R0; E: R180 / MY
roots: st_E00 (E port column at the head gap; the 151-um E inner channel carries rs relays)

clocking.scheme: forwarded clock per hop, neighbour-relative; each hop a plain synchronous neighbour hop

latency.per_column_pitch: 2 registers (station + one 80-um lane relay): the 522.72-um pitch is longer than the 373-um hop

equal_age.note: pads now sit on each head's n_d / s_d outputs (516 b x 2), not on station outputs: in a chain a head input cannot be delayed without delaying the heads behind it.  Same pads in the comb variant.

static_schedule_contract.rule: owner 2026-10-14 static-cycle schedule: a word presented at edge E leaves d_out0 at E+1 and d_out1 at E+1+PAD; no stall input; faults on the hook's cluster / head fault chain

open_outputs_note: the outermost station of each side has no onward child (open OUTPUT, no tied input); NOUT=1 variant if the port bind refuses it

benches.name: tb_bcast_exact
benches.what: 10^5 random 1,567-b words incl. back-to-back / idle (go=0) / all-ones / all-zeros: d_out0 == d_in at +1 edge, d_out1 == d_in at +1+PAD edges, bit for bit

benches.name: tb_chain_golden
benches.what: xs_tap golden head-word stream -> 24 stations + lane relays + pads per die_top_htree.json -> 24 head input models per side: every head sees the golden word on its table edge, all 4 heads of a group on the SAME edge

benches.name: tb_head_cluster
benches.what: unchanged qfd_xhead_*_w130 RTL fed by the station: n_d / s_d into C_B16 bc<lc> bit-identical to today's corridor words for the same tile ids (tids per cluster_contract die_head_tids)

benches.name: tb_static
benches.what: no ready / valid / credit port; latency invariant to data and to reset release; reset clears go

benches.name: tb_mutants
benches.what: MUT=1 drops PAD (age skew); MUT=2 flips one fill bit; MUT=3 swaps d_out0 / d_out1: each must FAIL tb_bcast_exact / tb_chain_golden

benches.name: tb_throughput
benches.what: production shape: one head word per edge for 10^5 edges; measured = price (1 + PAD)

benches.name: sta
benches.what: SS setup / FF hold at 1.2 GHz in the 330 x 920.16 frame, 373-um neighbour hops on every face

verdict: stations variant vs the relayed head chain (comb) on the final grid: broadcast -1 stage (94 vs 95 to the far-band tile), same reduction (49); cut 0.769 / 23 lines > 0.55 vs 0.536 / 0: the station chain shares the head-gap lanes with the near-band rs words.  Does NOT meet the q3h3 launch rule (fewer stages at an equal or better cut).
